name: grokbot
description: Self-hosted AI agent teammates with their own operating systems. Multi-model, runs locally on macOS (Apple Silicon) via Docker.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.app:build: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.app:dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.app:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
